messages:
sophie: FYI NovaEdge SI just flagged increased tail latency after we flipped to quantized-v2 on their Dedicated pool. They see GPU stalls ~100-300ms per token on long-chat. Can we triage? @aj
aj: on it. do we have a request id / example? can you drop a small repro + timing? pinging @greg for field env details.
greg: repro steps — reproduce in staging with the same sequence lengths: 1) load model quantized-v2 2) warm cache with a 1k token prompt 3) run concurrent 8 sessions 4) observe p99 spikes. attaching truncated logs: ```ERR: kernel sync timeout at step 342; nvml power cap err```
aj: hmm looks like kernel fallback on that kernel version. quick check: what's CUDA driver on their dedicated nodes? also, any recent host kernel updates?
maria: I have the SI's node inventory. CUDA 12.1, drivers 535.*, host kernel 5.15. They recently upgraded to our quantized model last night at 02:10 UTC (deploy 3187600000).
deploy-bot: Deploy 3187600000 -> prod-dedicated/novaedge completed by ops-ci at 2026-03-21T02:10:12Z :white_check_mark:
aj: option A: roll back to float32 model variant (redwood/rlm-base:v1) — quick and safe. option B: patch runtime kernel selection to force different kernel for that sequence length (riskier). I can push rollback in 10m if we want.
sophie: client asks for minimal downtime. prefer rollback. greg can you confirm rollback command & take lead? i'll notify the SI PM and schedule 30m handoff.
greg: taking lead. rollback cmd I'll run: ```rdwctl deploy rollback --tenant novaedge --pool prod-dedicated --model redwood/rlm-base:v1 --confirm``` will monitor p50/p99 after. starting in 5m.
aj: also add temporary routing rule to send >512 token requests to fallback pool to avoid hitting quantized path while we debug.
sophie: thanks — add route change please. I'll update the runbook section 'si-delivery/rollbacks' after this and ping legal for a customer note. :thumbsup:
maria: I scheduled a 30m sync at 15:30 PST with NovaEdge PM and SI lead to review root cause post-mitigation. invite sent.
greg: rollback complete. p99 down from 1.2s -> 230ms on validation set. monitoring.
sophie: beautiful. tagging for postmortem: @aj, @greg, @maria. we'll file a short RCA and a marketplace note. closing thread when postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
